text: WHO WRITES THE FINAL TEXT OF A LAW?
sub: When the two chambers pass different versions, neither text is the law yet.

credit: Photo: Philippine News Agency photo by Avito Dalan, Wikimedia Commons, Public domain

head: THE 1987 CONSTITUTION
body: No bill passed by either House shall become a law unless it has passed three readings on separate days, and printed copies thereof in its final form have been distributed to its Members three days before its passage, except when the President certifies to the necessity of its immediate enactment to meet a public calamity or emergency.

items.small: In each chamber, on separate days.
Passed on third reading by the House.
Passed on third reading by the Senate.
The differences are settled by a panel.

src: Abakada Guro Party List v. Ermita, G.R. No. 168056 (2005), quoting Senate Rule XII, Sec. 35

credit: Photo: P1898, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 4.0

head: TOLENTINO V. SECRETARY OF FINANCE
body: it is within the power of a conference committee to include in its report an entirely new provision ... germane to the subject of the bills before the committee ... The result is a third version, which is considered an 'amendment in the nature of a substitute.'
hl: germane to the subject of the bills
src: Tolentino v. Secretary of Finance, G.R. No. 115455, 25 Aug 1994, lawphil.net (primary)

items.small: No line by line amendments on the floor.

text: THE LAST EDIT HAPPENS IN COMMITTEE
sub: For major bills, the final wording is settled by the conference committee.
